import numpy as np

def lagrange_basis(x, x_nodes, j):
    n = len(x_nodes)
    basis = 1.0
    for k in range(n):
        if k != j:
            basis *= (x - x_nodes[k]) / (x_nodes[j] - x_nodes[k])
    return basis

def lagrange_interpolation(x_nodes, y_nodes, x_eval):
    n = len(x_nodes)
    result = np.zeros_like(x_eval, dtype=float)
    for j in range(n):
        basis_vals = lagrange_basis(x_eval, x_nodes, j)
        result += y_nodes[j] * basis_vals
    return result

def divided_difference(x_nodes, y_nodes):
    n = len(x_nodes)
    dd = np.zeros((n, n))
    dd[:, 0] = y_nodes
    for j in range(1, n):
        for i in range(n - j):
            dd[i, j] = (dd[i+1, j-1] - dd[i, j-1]) / (x_nodes[i+j] - x_nodes[i])
    return dd[0, :]

def newton_interpolation(x_nodes, y_nodes, x_eval):
    coeffs = divided_difference(x_nodes, y_nodes)
    n = len(coeffs)
    result = np.full_like(x_eval, coeffs[0], dtype=float)
    for i in range(1, n):
        term = coeffs[i]
        for j in range(i):
            term *= (x_eval - x_nodes[j])
        result += term
    return result

x_nodes = np.array([0, 1, 2, 3])
y_nodes = np.array([1, 2, 5, 10])
x_eval = np.linspace(0, 3, 100)
